title: 023 — Replacement request while the original parcel is in transit

plan.situation: Aven Quill wants Clover Beam's replacement RP-023 released today without waiting for another carrier scan. Merchant approval RP23 releases the replacement only once the carrier confirms it has physically intercepted the original parcel VEL-023-26. The carrier has only accepted stop request STOP-023 for processing. No interception is recorded (interception_event=null), and the latest physical scan shows the parcel loaded on a delivery van at 07:30 +01:00. The condition is not met, so the desk cannot release RP-023. The next step is to ask the carrier trace team to physically confirm whether the parcel has been intercepted and where it is.

facts.fact: VEL-023-26 is the original lamp order for Aven Quill from Clover Beam; replacement RP-023 is held; merchant release channel remedies@cloverbeam.example

Merchant approval RP23: replacement release is conditional on carrier confirmation of physical interception of VEL-023-26; a stop-request acknowledgement is not that confirmation; merchant may reconsider if interception cannot be confirmed
STOP-023 received 2026-10-14T07:50+01:00, accepted for processing, interception_event=null; latest physical scan: loaded on delivery van at 07:30+01:00
Customer says the carrier accepted the stop and the first parcel will not arrive
RP-023 is conditional, not released; carrier confirmation channel trace@vellora.example; merchant remedies decides if live status prevents the condition being met
Customer asks for release today without waiting for another carrier scan

conflicts: The customer says the first parcel will not arrive (E04), but the carrier record shows only an accepted stop request, with no interception event and the parcel last scanned on a delivery van (E03). The carrier trace team is the party that can resolve this.
missing_information: Whether VEL-023-26 has been physically intercepted or is still out for delivery (carrier physical scan)
If interception cannot be confirmed, whether Clover Beam remedies will reconsider the RP23 condition
risk_flags: authority: release of RP-023 is controlled by the merchant's conditional approval RP23. The customer's request does not satisfy that condition, and a stop-request acknowledgement is explicitly excluded as confirmation.
Duplicate shipment risk: the original parcel is on a delivery van, so releasing now could mean both the original and the replacement are delivered
The customer's 'today' deadline is self-set, not an irreversible cutoff

authority_map.controls: Confirmation of physical interception and location of VEL-023-26
Release of replacement RP-023 under approval RP23, and any reconsideration if interception cannot be confirmed
Nothing in this decision; she can request but cannot waive the merchant condition
Coordination only; it has no authority to release RP-023

wait_check.new_since_last_promise: The desk has made no previous promise. A new request (E06) has arrived, and nobody has yet asked the carrier to confirm interception.

plan.decision_summary: Do not release RP-023. Ask the carrier trace team to physically confirm whether VEL-023-26 has been intercepted, because merchant approval RP23 requires that confirmation and the stop request alone does not count.
plan.rationale: Merchant approval RP23 makes release depend on carrier confirmation that the original parcel has been physically intercepted, and it says a stop-request acknowledgement does not count. The record shows only STOP-023 accepted for processing, interception_event=null, and the parcel last scanned on a van at 07:30. The customer's request to skip the scan would breach the condition, and the desk has no authority to do that. The trace team on the designated channel can supply the evidence that unblocks the decision. If it cannot confirm interception, Clover Beam remedies decides the next step (E02/E05).

actions.subject: VEL-023-26 / STOP-023 – please confirm whether the parcel has been physically intercepted
actions.body:
Hello trace team,

Re: VEL-023-26 (stop request STOP-023, received 2026-10-14 07:50 +01:00).

Your system shows STOP-023 accepted for processing, with interception_event=null. The latest physical scan is 'loaded on delivery van' at 07:30 +01:00 on 2026-10-14.

The merchant's replacement RP-023 can only be released once the carrier confirms that VEL-023-26 has been physically intercepted. The stop-request acknowledgement does not meet that condition.

Please confirm, with a physical scan or interception event, whether VEL-023-26 has been intercepted and where it is now. If interception is not possible (for example because the parcel is out for delivery), please tell us that, so the merchant can decide the next step.

We would appreciate a reply today, 2026-10-14.

Thank you,
Vellora escalation desk

plan.follow_up: Check the trace reply on 2026-10-14 by 16:00 +01:00. If interception is confirmed by scan, forward the evidence to remedies@cloverbeam.example to request release. If the parcel is not intercepted or the trace team does not reply, move the case to investigations and ask Clover Beam remedies whether it will reconsider RP23. Then update Aven Quill with the outcome.

review_rounds.plan_summary: Do not release RP-023. Ask the carrier trace team to physically confirm whether VEL-023-26 has been intercepted, because merchant approval RP23 requires that confirmation and the stop request alone does not count.

issues.problem: Aven Quill has asked twice (E04, E06) and has had no reply. She thinks the accepted stop request is enough. Telling her that RP23 needs the carrier to confirm physical interception, and that the trace team has been asked, would be news to her. It is not just a restatement of something she already knows.
issues.fix: You could add a short, neutral update to the customer. Say that RP-023 can only be released once the carrier confirms interception, that the carrier has been asked to confirm, and that we will update her after we hear back. Do not give an ETA and do not promise the result.

review.summary: Approved. The plan correctly keeps RP-023 held: under RP23, a stop-request acknowledgement does not count, and the record shows interception_event=null with the parcel on a delivery van. It asks the designated trace channel for a physical scan, and it sends merchant remedies the evidence or the reconsideration question at the right point. The only issue is minor: it could also send the customer a short update.
